UNIVERSAL EIGHT-AXIS COVENANT ALIGNMENT SYSTEM

This package expands the attached four-axis alignment system while preserving all 81 original profile names.

Core profile axes: Altruism, Lawfulness, Cooperation, Honor.
Expression axes: Mercy, Transformation, Autonomy, Restraint.

The twenty-two attached Universal deities are the only pantheon used. Each of the twenty-two attached classes retains its canonical one-to-one deity assignment.

Profile names are generated only from the original four axes. The additional axes create a readable expression line rather than thousands of extra names.

Original document attribution retained in the DOCX exactly as supplied: William Saville, also known as The Transgender T-Rex, #TheTransgenderTRex.
